method.matchups: Each of 120 canonical arena bots faces two same-arena peers from both sides.
method.core: Common base core; this matrix isolates module deck composition.
method.module_levels: Base combat level in matches; levels 1/8/15 are audited separately in module_matrix.
method.synthetic_topology: Support and system modules are placed adjacent to the modules they affect.

decision.severe_energy_overload: At load ratios above 1.6, damage now remains penalized at 75% instead of incorrectly returning to 100%.
decision.cooler: No automatic +5% fire-rate change; preserve the current heat/control role until real-player telemetry is sufficient.
decision.attack_stacking: Do not ban attack-heavy decks; use the measured bucket rates as a telemetry baseline.
